content.text: Midline bony tender is frx red flag
Norm: more prominent at C7 & T1  -esp. w forward flex of neck
Atrophy or asymmetry: chronic n.-root lesion or disuse
scoliosis, postural asymmetry, or musc imbalance
Canadian C-spine rule b4 clearing neck in trauma
: grating sound or sensation prod by friction b/n bone & cartilage or frx part of bone
- Tone: ↑: spasm, guarding                              - spasm: muscular strain
- Bony step-offs: subluxation                              - Crepitus: degen dz
- Tone: ↑: spasm, guarding                              - spasm: muscular strain
- Tender: muscular strain                                    - Crepitus: degen joint dz
- Asymmetry: atrophy (CN XI) or unilat spasm
- Tone: ↑: spasm, guarding                              - spasm: muscular strain
- Tender:  trigger points: myofascial pain       - crepitus: degen joint dz
- Asymmetry: torticollis -unilat SCM spasm/contracture or SCM mass
- Tone: ↑ : spasm, guarding                             - spasm: muscular strain
- Tender: strain or torticolli                                 - crepitus: degen joint dz
Arm pain w extend/rotation: foraminal narrowing/radiculopathy.
- Pain or limit: strain or disc                                                  **w fever: meningismus**
- pain: facet arthropathy or foraminal narrowing (radicular)
- pain:       same side: facet        -         opposite: muscular stretch
- Pain, limit: facet OA or atlantoaxial patho
Both SCM and trapezius are CN XI.
- Weakness, shoulder droop: CN XI lesion
compression downward from top of skull
Neck pain radiate down same arm (of turned side)
hand on head on affected side
ipsilat cervical radicular Sx/S relief w hand on head
